facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party 975 gold for the barrow treasure (three-quarters price), payable once the caravans flow to Brandonsford again.
The party pledged Cedric's promissory note to the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda to recruit them, and owes them payment from it once it is paid.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated how much of the note goes to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda or on what terms.
